name: MedRisk-Bench
description:
MedRisk Benchmark is used for medical risk assessment. 
The Benchmark is made up with two version with 1232 test samples for each:
MedRisk-Quantitative: which focuses on the score caculation for medical risk prediction.
MedRisk-Qualitative: which focuses on the severity for medical condition/disease.
Full data release can be found at Github
evaluation_method: composite_score (RMSE for quantitative, F1/accuracy for qualitative)
general_score_metric: composite (RMSE for quantitative, F1/accuracy for qualitative)
reputation: Newer Hugging Face benchmark for medical risk assessment with limited adoption; mainly used in small-scale evaluations.
